create_agent_default: create a default SPIRAL agent with action spec, input shape, grid shape, and action order
build_autoregressive_heads: build autoregressive action heads for spatial and non-spatial action generation
run_agent_step: run a single step of the agent given observation, step type, and previous state
test_initial_state: test the agent initial state with a given batch size for LSTM and previous action
review_torso_head: review the agent torso encoder and autoregressive head for canvas observation processing
